hook.name: BnbableHook
hook.description: A fee hook for BNB/token pools that takes direction-specific fees on the BNB side of each swap (buy fee and sell fee, both in BPS) and distributes them as claimable BNB rewards to up to 5 configured recipient wallets; a fixed 0.10% protocol cut is deducted first. Only pools pre-registered by the immutable launcher address can use this hook.
